mutations.name: the console never dials the factory
mutations.find: { source: "factory", url: `http://127.0.0.1:${config.factoryPort}/events`, headers: async () => accept, pick: factoryIds },
kills: the factory relay source dials the factory's /events with no broker token and relays each frame as its run id alone
the factory relay source redials a dropped factory stream with the same doubling backoff, announcing each reopen

mutations.name: any string passes as a run id
kills: factoryIds drops a run id with spaces or slashes, a non-string run id, a frame with none, and data that is not an object

mutations.name: a non-string run id is kept
mutations.replace: return runId !== undefined && RUN_ID.test(String(runId)) ? { runId: String(runId) } : {};
kills: factoryIds drops a run id with spaces or slashes, a non-string run id, a frame with none, and data that is not an object

mutations.name: the factory dial sends the broker token
mutations.replace: headers: async () => ({ ...accept, [TOKEN_HEADER]: await readToken(config.agentChatTokenPath) }), pick: factoryIds
kills: the factory relay source dials the factory's /events with no broker token and relays each frame as its run id alone

mutations.name: the backoff doubles past its cap
kills: the events relay backs off between refused dials, doubling to the cap, and relays nothing
the factory relay source redials a dropped factory stream with the same doubling backoff, announcing each reopen
